Avraxas Organico supplied exact titles and one 133 BPM retailer identity but no track-specific behavioural evidence, so it was excluded before resolution rather than promoted by title, tag, or tempo.

House, psytrance, melodic, vocal-led, peak-time, impact-led, broken-tempo, and protected-ending-only results were excluded from the current canonical grammar.
